title: Affordable housing stock shrinks, premium home inventory jumps 43%: Report

Lower-priced properties below one crore rupees are selling faster, showing inventory declines. The overall time to sell existing stock increased to six quarters. Premium housing segments experienced both rising inventory and increased sales activity. Older housing stock is being absorbed, indicating buyer preference for near-completion properties.

title: Nasa's Perseverance finds Mars can have warm ground but freezing air
content: Mars presents unique seasonal experiences with surface and air temperatures differing greatly.  This phenomenon occurs because the planet's thin atmosphere cannot effectively distribute solar heat.  Nasa's Perseverance rover has directly measured these sharp temperature contrasts near Jezero Crater.  Such extreme variations pose significant challenges for rover and future human mission designs.  Understanding these differences is crucial for engineering equipment to survive Martian conditions.

title: Person-to-person transactions to remain free: Govt clarifies no charges for UPI users

title: Too far, too late: Why pregnant women are still dying en route to care

Inaccessible roads and a lack of ambulances hinder emergency response in these remote areas. Additionally, the scarcity of specialist doctors exacerbates potentially life-threatening obstetric situations. These systemic issues often result in tragic outcomes for mothers and infants alike. Therefore, enhancing healthcare facilities in rural regions is essential to safeguard lives.

Consequently, this reform aims to alleviate congestion and enhance the efficiency of public services through technology-driven solutions.
